commands.name: script-executable-and-stdlib-only
commands.run: test -x claude/skills/voice/scripts/voice.py && python3 -c "import ast,sys; src=open('claude/skills/voice/scripts/voice.py').read(); mods={(n.module or '').split('.')[0] for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(src)) if isinstance(n, ast.ImportFrom)} | {a.name.split('.')[0] for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(src)) if isinstance(n, ast.Import) for a in n.names}; bad=sorted(m for m in mods if m and m not in sys.stdlib_module_names); print('non-stdlib imports:', bad) if bad else None; sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)"

commands.name: lint-generated-pr-body-flags-filler-hedge-empty-heading
commands.run:
out=$(python3 claude/skills/voice/scripts/voice.py lint --kind pr-body --file claude/skills/voice/scripts/tests/fixtures/pr_body_generated.md); rc=$?; test "$rc" -eq 1 && printf '%s
' "$out" | grep -q '^filler:' && printf '%s
' "$out" | grep -q '^hedge:' && printf '%s
' "$out" | grep -q '^empty-heading:'

commands.name: lint-clean-pr-body-is-silent
commands.run: out=$(python3 claude/skills/voice/scripts/voice.py lint --kind pr-body --file claude/skills/voice/scripts/tests/fixtures/pr_body_clean.md); rc=$?; test "$rc" -eq 0 && test -z "$out"

commands.name: lint-jira-title-shape
commands.run: python3 claude/skills/voice/scripts/voice.py lint --kind jira-title --file claude/skills/voice/scripts/tests/fixtures/jira_title_generated.txt | grep -q '^title-shape:' && python3 claude/skills/voice/scripts/voice.py lint --kind jira-title --file claude/skills/voice/scripts/tests/fixtures/jira_title_clean.txt

commands.name: dry-run-never-invokes-codex
commands.run: out=$(VOICE_CODEX_BIN=/usr/bin/false python3 claude/skills/voice/scripts/voice.py rewrite --kind pr-body --file claude/skills/voice/scripts/tests/fixtures/pr_body_generated.md --dry-run); rc=$?; test "$rc" -eq 0 && printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q '=== TEXT ===' && printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q -F "$(sed -n '3p' claude/skills/voice/rules.md)"

commands.name: skill-dir-tracked
commands.run: grep -qxF '!/voice/' claude/skills/.gitignore && git ls-files --error-unmatch claude/skills/voice/SKILL.md claude/skills/voice/rules.md claude/skills/voice/scripts/voice.py >/dev/null

commands.name: skill-frontmatter
commands.run: head -n 1 claude/skills/voice/SKILL.md | grep -qx -- '---' && grep -q '^name: voice$' claude/skills/voice/SKILL.md && grep -q '^description: ' claude/skills/voice/SKILL.md && grep -q '^## Call sites' claude/skills/voice/SKILL.md

commands.name: new-files-ascii-no-emoji
commands.run: git ls-files -z claude/skills/voice | python3 -c "import sys; files=[p for p in sys.stdin.buffer.read().split(b'\0') if p]; bad=[p.decode() for p in files if any(b > 127 for b in open(p,'rb').read())]; print('non-ascii:', bad) if bad else None; sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)"

commands.name: review-skills-untouched
commands.run: git diff --quiet 41dd7a164e858ca23dbda077dbbc2f69478118b3 -- claude/skills/co-review claude/skills/codex-plan-review claude/skills/codex-spec-review claude/skills/ship claude/skills/post-merge claude/commands/pr.md claude/commands/jira.md codex/AGENTS.md codex/skills
